subject: Civil Engineering
title: The I-35W Bridge Collapse
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The I-35W Bridge Collapse.

hook.text: On August 1, 2007, an eight-lane bridge fell into the Mississippi during rush hour.

buildup.text: The I-35W bridge in Minneapolis was a steel truss built in 1967 — forty years old.

discovery.text: Investigators found gusset plates — the steel connectors — were half as thick as needed.

twist.text: Construction equipment for a repaving project added extra weight the day it fell.

climax.text: After the collapse, Congress funded inspection of every structurally deficient bridge.

punchline.text: Undersized connectors hid in plain sight for forty years.

quiz.question: What was the root cause of the I-35W bridge collapse?
options: Gusset plates were undersized in the original design
A ship struck one of the bridge piers
